verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an accounting SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no first-party 'export all data' feature or open-format bulk export. The REST API is a developer building block. ZUGFeRD/XRechnung support covers e-invoice exchange, and the tax-advisor interface is an adjacent data-transfer feature; neither is a full-account export that lets a user leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
